vocabulary.definition: extremely overweight, having an excessive amount of body fat
vocabulary.example: More people are obese than starving in today's society.

vocabulary.definition: the chemical processes that occur within a living organism in order to maintain life
vocabulary.example: Excess fat disrupts your metabolism and can lead to health issues.

vocabulary.definition: extremely appealing or attractive to the taste, often to an unhealthy degree
vocabulary.example: Processed foods are made hyperpalatable to make them irresistible to consumers.

vocabulary.definition: relating to glands that secrete hormones directly into the bloodstream
vocabulary.example: Fat is not just a storage organ, but also an endocrine organ that produces hormones.

vocabulary.definition: a localized physical condition in which part of the body becomes reddened, swollen, hot, and often painful, especially as a reaction to injury or infection
vocabulary.example: Excess fat can lead to chronic inflammation in the body.

vocabulary.definition: a hormone produced by the pancreas that regulates blood sugar levels
vocabulary.example: Insulin resistance can develop when cells become less responsive to the effects of insulin.
